items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And Buster Moten was conducting the orchestra and playing guitar.

ctx.x: into Ben Webster and naturally, he being the jazz player he invited me out to the theater. And we had a big jam session out at the theater. So Benny Moten said, why don't you come on to go -- I'm making some changes in the band, why don't you come on and go to Kansas City. I said, of course, because I wasn't doing nothing.

So Macleo Burchell was his manager. We all drove on in his car, his Ford. And they had their bus, or whatever it is, and we went to Kansas City. And Benny revamped his band. I was put on lead alto with Ben Webster and Jack Washington. And we had Eddie Durham on banjo -- on guitar and trombone. And we had Dan Minor on trombone. And we had Hot Lips Paige. And at that time we had Joe Smith, Russell Smith's brother on trumpet and Hot Lips Paige and Joe Keyes. He was my roommate. And gee, Joe, he was playing first.…
